name: yt-knowledge-base
description: Community-curated YouTube knowledge base. TanStack Start + Strapi, with AI-generated summaries per video.

scripts.setup: yarn install && yarn setup:client && yarn setup:server && yarn setup:site
scripts.dev: yarn concurrently "cd server && yarn develop" "npx wait-on http://localhost:1340 && cd client && yarn dev"
scripts.install:all: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd server install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd client install --frozen-lockfile && yarn --cwd site install --frozen-lockfile
